listing.name: Gears of War 2 — Fenix Reborn 0.1 (josuloku-new)
listing.summary: Upstream describes experimental image and mod options. Support for a complete campaign is unknown. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Gears of War 2 Xbox 360 disc ISO. This guide does not specify the exact supported region, revision or file hash. Check the project’s original-file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the FenixReborn setup instructions with your own ISO. Setup downloads tools, then generates and compiles the game code locally.

warnings: Upstream describes experimental image and mod options. Support for a complete campaign is unknown.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
